title: launchSettings.json
description: How the project starts with Run and Debug: launch profiles.

workingDirectory.description: The working directory (default: the project folder).

applicationUrl.description: The URLs the app listens on, separated by `;` (sets `ASPNETCORE_URLS`).

launchBrowser.description: Whether to open a browser when the app starts.

launchUrl.description: The path or URL the browser opens.

dotnetRunMessages.description: Whether `dotnet run` shows its build messages.

inspectUri.description: The Blazor WebAssembly debugging proxy URL.

hotReloadEnabled.description: Whether Hot Reload applies edits while the app runs.

nativeDebugging.description: Whether to debug native code too (Windows).
